research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Instabase is researching systems and methods for providing user interfaces for configuration and design of flows for extracting information from documents via large language models, as well as spatial-aware information extraction from electronic source documents. Additional work includes identifying document transitions within document bundles and enabling user interfaces to converse with a corpus of electronic documents. These areas reflect a focus on automating document processing and data analysis.

about_short_description.short_description: Instabase is an Agentic Automation company that uses AI agents to automate document processing and data analysis.

product.name: Instabase AI Hub
product.description: A generative AI platform for content understanding that enables users to converse with documents, automate workflows, and build custom applications for unstructured data processing.

product.name: Document Processing Automation
product.description: A suite of tools to classify, extract, clean, and validate data from unstructured documents to automate document processing workflows.

product.name: Human-in-the-Loop Review Workflows
product.description: A system to enable manual review and correction of AI-extracted data to improve accuracy and manage review operations at scale.

product.name: Production Deployment and Monitoring
product.description: Tools to deploy, manage, and monitor production-ready document processing applications with version control and performance metrics.

product.name: Conversational AI and Chatbots
product.description: Conversational AI tools that enable users to query documents and knowledge bases and create chatbots for on-demand insights and data analysis.

product.name: Data Connectivity and Integration
product.description: Connectors and tools to link various data sources and unlock unstructured content from multiple file formats and storage systems.
